title: tc-knowledge-source-manager
description:
The sources a knowledge base answers from – ingestion state and progress, documents and chunks, last sync and
schedule, stale and duplicate warnings – with add, resync, pause, remove and a handoff to chunk review.

sources.description: The sources. Changed by the user (remove, schedule) unless a tc-sources-change listener calls preventDefault()

schedules.description: The sync schedules a source can be set to

selected.description: The id of the open source, or null

show.description: Which sources show: "all", or "attention" – the failed, stale and duplicate ones

now.description: The moment last syncs are counted to, in epoch ms; unset shows their dates

noAdd.description: Hides Add source, for a read-only view

noReview.description: Hides Review chunks, when the app has no chunk review

maxHeight.description: The list's height before it scrolls, in px

kind.description: "file", "site" or "connector" pick the icon; any other word gets a generic one

location.description: Where it comes from: a path, a URL, a workspace – shown under the name when picked

error.description: Why it failed, in a sentence

chunks.description: How many chunks those documents became

lastSync.description: When it last synced: a Date or epoch ms (relative to `now` when set), or text as it is

schedule.description: The id of its sync schedule, one of `schedules`

stale.description: The app flags it as stale: true, or the reason ("The site changed 40 pages since")

duplicateOf.description: The app flags it as covering the same documents as another source: that source's id, or a name
